'''Ramona''' (Japanese: '''ハルカ''' ''Haruka'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP190|The Stolen Stones!]]''. She and her younger brother [[Keegan]] run a courier business with the help of their {{p|Arcanine}}.

{{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} first met Ramona when she and Keegan saved them from a rock-slide with the help of their {{p|Arcanine}}. {{an|Brock}} was impressed that Ramona could control a tough {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} so easily and began flirting with her immediately after.

Ramona and her brother were traveling to a city near [[Olivine City]] to deliver [[Fire Stone]]s, which were to be handed out as prizes for a {{type|Fire}} Pokémon competition. However, the Fire Stones were stolen by {{TRT}}. To recover the stones, Ramona, Brock, and {{an|Misty}} went after [[James]], while Ash and Keegan pursued [[Jessie]]. However, Ramona's group fell in a pitfall trap and remained there until Brock used his {{TP|Brock|Onix}} to get them out.

They soon found Team Rocket again and Ramona commanded her two Arcanine to use {{m|Fire Spin}} on their [[Team Rocket's mechas|balloon]], sending them crashing to the ground. Ramona got the Fire Stones back and she and Keegan delivered them to the competition headquarters on time.
